## Question or suspected issue

What behaviour, audit finding, or design question needs investigating?

## Current behaviour

Describe what happens today. Include relevant product flows, configuration, or
environment details.

## Evidence

Link to relevant source files, logs, screenshots, tests, documentation, or
related issues. Record what was checked and what remains uncertain.

## Scope

- [ ] Investigation only; no implementation proposed yet
- [ ] Reproduction or test case needed
- [ ] Documentation may be stale or inherited from an upstream fork
- [ ] Potential security or data-integrity impact

## Expected outcome

What should this investigation produce?

- [ ] Confirmed issue
- [ ] Rejected or already fixed
- [ ] Recommended implementation issue
- [ ] Documentation correction
- [ ] Further investigation required

## Area

Add the relevant area label, such as `backend`, `frontend`, `scraper`,
`notifications`, `database`, or `security`.

## Related issues

<!-- Link related issues, pull requests, or upstream findings here. -->
